rows.en: S-so strong!!
Th-that's incredible power!!
What power!!
We're being pushed back!?
We're being pushed back!?
We're being pushed back!?
We're being pushed back!?
Oh!? You guys are really going at it~!! Big game this time, huh?
Birth!!
All riiight! I'll hit it with one big blast, so I'm counting on you guys for the rest!!
"CELL BURST!!"
Now's our chance! Attack!!
Alright! What a haul, what a haul!!
So how 'bout it, Anko! Did you rake in a pile of Core Medals!?
Damn it... Only three. Kazari made off with all the rest...
Seriously...?
...Fine, whatever. I'll take them back sooner or later, count on it.
Heh... Sorry, but I'll be taking the Cores. We've got to plan our next move too, after all.
Still, this experiment was a success. My research will now take a great leap forward.
Oh? Did you get a handle on something? Heh... Now this I'm looking forward to.
Let us go, Kazari! Fuhahahahahahahahaha!!
OOO, I'm leaving these Core Medals with you. It's the bare minimum we managed to take back.
Obtained Core Medals. A new OOO skill has been unlocked.
...Well, I got the bare minimum of Core Medals. Maybe I'll let OOO try them next time.
Obtained Core Medals. A new OOO skill has been unlocked.
Welp, that's the job done!!
I'm gonna keep on collecting medals on my own.
But if you call me, I'll lend a hand anytime!
Hey, we're moving too. The armory key's gotta be around here somewhere.
...Heeey, wait for meee~
It's me, Kanegon~ Don't leave me behiiind~
Pleeease~ Help me ouuut~ I'm not anybody suspicious~
What, you're still here...?
This one doesn't seem like a bad sort. Let's help.
Tch... Do whatever you want.
Aaah... Thank yooouuu~~
OOO and the others decided to shelter Kanegon and take their new charge back to base.
Took in Kanegon, who had been held captive.
All right. We'll take you under our protection.
Aaah... Thank yooouuu~~

You don't seem like a bad sort. Alright, come with us!

Look! That looks like some kind of control panel.
It was the security management system for this entire area.
{8074} and the others worked the panel and released every lock.
Nice. We should be able to get into the armory now.
There are all kinds of weapons and ammo. But most seem made only for kaijin and kaiju.
I've never seen any of these weapons before. We'll take back whatever looks like what we need.
{8074} and the others decided to take back a few things that looked like bombs.
We're heading back to base. If we show Hikari, he'll figure something out.
{8074} and the others returned to base and handed the bomb-like objects to Hikari.
So these are the bombs you brought back...
...I see.
This is "Spiner."

notes.note: Continues the 11-row leader block from story_058 (#0.82-#0.92), order per 0337.bla Pt_Chara_Check as story_058 found: OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. So #0.86 Rider 1, #0.87 Mebius (same JP as #0.85, same English), #0.88 Zero, #0.89-#0.92 Nu/Zeta/00/Wing Zero (identical).
Birth Buster's 'Cell Burst' call, in the source's device-voice brackets; rendered as a caps voice line in quotes per the style guide.
Birth uses the fisherman's 'big catch' cry for the Cell Medals he scooped up; rendered 'What a haul'.
Ankh; dropped subject restored ('I'll take them back'). 'them' = the Core Medals Kazari took.
Kazari, apparently a cut-away to Kazari and Ikadevil leaving with the medals; 'Cores' = Core Medals (source shortens it).
#0.114/#0.115 = OOO in party (Ankh hands the medals to OOO); #0.117/#0.118 = OOO not in party. System line made plural since Ankh recovered three medals.
Ankh to the party; the armory key ties back to the earlier armory/bomb line.
#0.124-#0.126, #0.130 and the repeated thanks rows are Kanegon (no speaker recovered). Kanegon is g=n; narration avoids pronouns ('their new charge').
OOO-party branch: #0.127/#0.129 Ankh (curt), #0.128 OOO (polite, suggests helping). Speakers inferred from wording and the following OOO narration row.
System message; 'hogo' (take into protective custody) rendered 'Took in'.

Leader block #0.137-#0.173: each leader's line precedes Kanegon's thanks and a narration row naming the leader (Mebius, Zero, W/Shotaro, Den-O/Momotaros, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, 00). #0.173 has no narration row; by the 11-leader order it is probably Wing Zero (identical JP to #0.169, identical English).
Ankh; dropped subject restored with Hikari (m) as the one who will figure it out.
Hikari (speaker not recovered; the party just handed him the bombs). #0.15-#0.18 all Hikari.
'Spiner': the high-performance explosive developed by the Earth Defense Force in Ultraseven (story_060 #0.20 confirms). Not in glossary; spelling per Ultra Wiki.

report: 80/80 translated. Leader variant blocks voiced via the 0337.bla order story_058 established; #0.173 probably Wing Zero (no narration row). Kanegon rows unlabelled (inferred). Not in glossary: Spiner (Ultraseven explosive), Birth's 'CELL BURST!!' call.
